glitches.object: a bicycle leaning on a post
glitches.why: [DRAFT] The bicycle is a nineteenth-century European invention.

glitches.object: a citation to a paper that was never written
glitches.why: [DRAFT] A plausible author, journal and year, assembled from the shape of real citations. Nothing is there.

glitches.object: a library function that doesn't exist
glitches.why: [DRAFT] It's named the way the library names things, so it looks right. The library never had it.

glitches.object: a famous quote given to the wrong person
glitches.why: [DRAFT] Quotes drift toward whoever is most famous for saying that kind of thing.

glitches.object: a confident date, a year off
glitches.why: [DRAFT] Close dates blur together. Confidence doesn't mean it was checked.

glitches.object: a statistic to two decimal places, with no source
glitches.why: [DRAFT] Precision can make a made-up number look measured. A real figure can say where it came from.

glitches.object: a court case that was never heard
glitches.why: [DRAFT] Case names follow a pattern that is easy to imitate. The case has to be checked in a law report.

glitches.object: a book its author never wrote
glitches.why: [DRAFT] A plausible title in a real author's style. Their bibliography doesn't have it.

glitches.object: a translation with a word that isn't in the original
glitches.why: [DRAFT] Translations smooth things over. Sometimes they add what the writer didn't say.
